codes.definition: The assistant answers questions about Korean government policy changes (effective dates, eligibility, benefit amounts, agencies) with specific details that are not backed by the retrieved sources, either because retrieval covered only part of the needed material or because generation dropped or invented content, while still attaching citation markers like [1] or [3].
evidencePatterns: specific effective dates such as 2026.9.18. or 2026년 8월 20일 stated with citation markers
details such as SCB pilot start month, 노란우산공제 limits or 대지급금 scope that may not appear in the cited passages
bracketed citations [1][3][5] attached to claims that the source may not support
answer truncated mid-sentence after a long list of policy items

codes.definition: The retrieval step returns sources that cover only part of what the question needs (graded as a search failure with partial coverage, e.g. 25-70%), so the answer is incomplete or limited to whatever was retrieved.
evidencePatterns: answer lists only a couple of items from the retrieved documents
citations limited to a few retrieved docs like [1][4]

codes.definition: The assistant gives a detailed, confidently cited answer even though the grader marked retrieval as failed with low source coverage (e.g. 18-40%), so parts of the answer are not supported by retrieved sources.
evidencePatterns: repeated bracket citations [1] attached to every bullet while coverage is low
answer asserts eligibility conclusions (e.g. '해당하는 것으로 보입니다') from a single partial source
specific figures (최대 7년 연장, 0.5%p 인하, 2026년 6월) stated with no corroborating sources
no disclosure to the user that retrieved sources only partly cover the question
